mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bot_api_keys (member_id, exchange, bot_target, api_key_enc, secret_key_enc, passphrase_enc, label) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{exchange}, #{botTarget}, #{apiKey}, #{secretKey}, #{passphrase}, #{label})
mapper.select: SELECT id, exchange, bot_target AS botTarget, api_key_enc AS apiKey, secret_key_enc AS secretKey, passphrase_enc AS passphrase, label, is_active AS active, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM bot_api_keys WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY bot_target, created_at DESC

SELECT id, exchange, bot_target AS botTarget, api_key_enc AS apiKey, secret_key_enc AS secretKey, passphrase_enc AS passphrase, label, is_active AS active, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM bot_api_keys WHERE id = #{param1} AND member_id = #{param2}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bot_api_keys WHERE id = #{param1} AND member_id = #{param2}
mapper.select: SELECT id, api_key_enc AS apiKey, secret_key_enc AS secretKey, passphrase_enc AS passphrase FROM bot_api_keys
mapper.update: UPDATE bot_api_keys SET api_key_enc = #{apiKey}, secret_key_enc = #{secretKey}, passphrase_enc = #{passphrase}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, exchange, bot_target AS botTarget, api_key_enc AS apiKey, secret_key_enc AS secretKey, passphrase_enc AS passphrase, label, is_active AS active FROM bot_api_keys WHERE member_id = #{param1} AND exchange = #{param2} AND bot_target = #{param3} AND is_active = true ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
